title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Leading up to the Japanese Derby, the dream race for all Umamusume, Admire Vega fails to be ranked the favorite in the popularity poll for the first time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That honor has gone to Narita Top Road. It's of no surprise to Admire Vega, who has watched her work hard to not let down her fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week, a member of the Golden Generation with a plethora of rivals herself, comes along to offer Admire Vega encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ready to face her rivals with everything she's got, Admire Vega heads out to compete in the Japanese Derby.
